subject.title: feat(android): read-only offline cache for chat sessions and transcripts

question: After the purge/list/license defects are fixed, may Android cache transcript text in an app-private plaintext Room database, or must this PR add encryption-at-rest before merge?
rationale: The PR intentionally persists conversation text on disk and the related umbrella issue carries security-review context, so automation should not infer the acceptable storage boundary.

options.title: Accept app-private cache after fixes
options.body: Require the purge, deep-session retention, license, and proof fixes, then record that app-private Room storage is acceptable for this disposable read-only cache.

options.title: Require encrypted cache
options.body: Make the Room cache encrypted-at-rest before merge if transcript text must not rely on app-private storage alone.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Hold this PR if offline transcript persistence is not accepted Android product direction yet.

recommendation.title: Accept app-private cache after fixes
recommendation.body: Require the purge, deep-session retention, license, and proof fixes, then record that app-private Room storage is acceptable for this disposable read-only cache.
